assertion: SVG text applies cumulative baseline shifts and alignment; decorations use the declaring element paint, follow positioned text and paths, and contribute opaque geometry to clips independently of fill/stroke. Both direct and use-instance text are covered.

browser.reason: Reviewed all three browsers and native/difference images. Chrome and WebKit agree on alignment-baseline; Firefox leaves top/bottom spans on the alphabetic baseline. All three include text decoration geometry in clips. Native positions, paint propagation, curve tracking and decoration bands agree with Chrome. Differences are text-edge rasterization, subpixel shaping and decoration antialiasing (8877 pixels, maximum 221); numeric tests separately assert cumulative shifts, typographic edges, clip geometry and backward seeks.
